description: List shopping carts (admin view), most recently updated first, with an optional status filter. Read-only. Each cart carries its status, customer (none for a guest), items, channel and timestamps; page with skip and limit. channel is the key of the sales channel the cart was started on (null for none): a buyer has one active cart per channel. To remove carts, delete_carts; placed orders are in list_orders.

skip.description: How many carts to skip - the paging offset

status.description: Only carts in this status; ordered = already turned into an order

name: list_carts
title: List carts
